full_query: I am a 33 years old female with right lower abdominal pain , what could it be?

shared_context.topic: causes of right lower abdominal pain

sentences: Right lower abdominal pain in a 33-year-old female can be caused by various conditions
Appendicitis: Inflammation of the appendix, often presenting with pain that starts near the navel and then shifts to the right lower abdomen
Associated symptoms may include nausea, vomiting, and fever
Ovarian Cyst: A fluid-filled sac on the ovary that can cause pain if it ruptures or becomes twisted (ovarian torsion)
Symptoms may include sudden, severe pain, nausea, and vomiting
Ectopic Pregnancy: A pregnancy that occurs outside the uterus, commonly in the fallopian tube
Symptoms include sharp, stabbing pain, vaginal bleeding, and dizziness
Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID): An infection of the female reproductive organs, often caused by sexually transmitted infections
Symptoms include pelvic pain, fever, and abnormal vaginal discharge
Gastrointestinal Issues: Conditions such as Crohn's disease, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), or a hernia can also cause right lower abdominal pain
Symptoms vary depending on the specific condition
A thorough clinical evaluation, including history, physical examination, and possibly imaging studies (e.g., ultrasound, CT scan), is necessary to determine the exact cause of the pain
